posts.title: Ryan Cohen ($GME CEO) bought $46.8M of GameStop stock
posts.alt_text: Animated walkthrough of two SEC Form 4 filings: Ryan Cohen, GameStop's CEO, bought 1,000,000 shares on Sep 10, 2026 and 1,150,680 shares on Sep 21, 2026, $46,769,622.50 in total; shares held after: 40,498,522 (+5.6%).

instagram.caption:
He runs GameStop. He bought more.

Ryan Cohen ($GME CEO) bought 2,150,680 GameStop shares in two purchases: 1,000,000 on Sep 10, 2026 at a $20.3759 weighted average, and 1,150,680 on Sep 21, 2026 at a $22.9375 weighted average. The filings say the individual purchases ranged from $20.0199 to $20.4699 and from $22.7600 to $23.0200. Total: $46,769,622.50 (about $46.8M).

Direct holdings after the second buy: 40,498,522 shares. That is 5.6% more than the 38,347,842 held before these two buys (40,498,522 − 2,150,680).

Source: two SEC Form 4 filings, filed Sep 10 and Sep 21, 2026. Links in the first comment.

instagram.caption:
Nancy Pelosi’s spouse bought $1M–$5M of Bloom Energy calls ($BE).

• Jul 24, 2026: 10,000 BE shares ($1,000,001–$5,000,000) and 100 BE calls, $100 strike, expiring 6/17/27 ($1,000,001–$5,000,000)
• Jul 28, 2026: 5,000 BE shares ($500,001–$1,000,000) and 100 more BE calls, same strike and expiry ($500,001–$1,000,000)
• Jul 24, 2026: 10,000 INTC shares ($500,001–$1,000,000) and 50 INTC calls, $50 strike, expiring 6/17/27 ($250,001–$500,000)

The report gives amounts as ranges only, so nothing is added up here.
